name: cdhowe_bcc_recessions
source: C.D. Howe Institute -- Business Cycle Council
notes: Hand-curated from the C.D. Howe Business Cycle Council's published historical dating list for Canadian recessions. Each recession entry follows the BCC's classification (the council assigns a 1-5 severity scale; that field is not included in this minimal schema and lives in the chart-internal companion JSON). The COVID-19 recession is exceptionally short and is included for completeness; some BCC communiques discuss it with a category-3 classification. Update cadence: roughly twice yearly when the BCC issues a communique. Maintainer instruction: when a new BCC communique re-dates the current expansion or marks a new recession, update only the trailing entries -- earlier entries are locked. Sibling file used by chart-builder for recession-band overlays on time-series panels in the GDP and Inflation basics layers.
